title: Introducing PointOne 2.0
summary: We're announcing a new generation of PointOne products this week, starting with PointOne Time 2.0.
body_markdown:
Since 2023, law firms have helped shape PointOne through thousands of conversations, feature requests, and the everyday interactions attorneys have with our products. PointOne 2.0 is the next generation of PointOne, built on everything we've learned.


The economics of legal services are changing. Growing a law firm requires more than winning new clients. It requires understanding how work gets done, what it costs, where human expertise creates value, and where opportunities for improvement lie.


"From day one, we've been building technology that adapts to the way lawyers work, never the other way around. Time tracking was our starting point, but the opportunity is much bigger. By capturing and structuring the data behind how work gets done, we can give firms a level of visibility into their operations they've never had before."


— **Jeremy Ben-Meir** , Co-founder and CTO of PointOne


This week, we're bringing that vision to life with the next generation of our products: Time, Rules, Review, and Intelligence.


## PointOne Time 2.0


PointOne Time 2.0 is our most automated, accurate, and intuitive time tracking experience yet. We're pushing the frontier of quality and accuracy: narratives that read like you wrote them, on the right matter, for the right amount of time.


PointOne adapts to the way attorneys work, never the other way around. Available across desktop, iPhone, and Android, PointOne makes timekeeping effortless. One click activates Auto-Capture, and attorneys get near-instant visibility into their day.


-


**Intelligent capture.** PointOne connects activity across emails, calendar events, calls, and computer activity to generate accurate, detailed time entries.


-


**Personalized narratives.** Each entry reflects the work performed and the attorney's individual writing style.


-


**Built-in compliance.** Entries follow the firm's and each client's billing rules.


Beyond time tracking, PointOne captures a valuable source of operational data. Regardless of the billing model, firms gain a clearer understanding of how work gets done, what it costs, and where they can improve.


To see PointOne Time 2.0 at your firm.


[Book a Demo](https://pointone.com/demo)


## More to come


PointOne Time 2.0 is just the beginning. Throughout the week, we'll introduce the next generation of Rules, Review, and Intelligence.


Four products to capture revenue, streamline billing, and bring visibility to the economics of legal work.


[Follow PointOne on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/pointoneai) to see each announcement as it happens.


## About PointOne


PointOne is the AI time entry and intelligence platform for law firms. Trusted by more than 250 law firms globally, including Am Law 50 firms, PointOne automates time entry end-to-end by using AI to create complete, compliant, invoice-ready timesheets.
